insights: Erdős #1090 general case is provable axiom-free in Lean: Mathlib's Hales-Jewett (Combinatorics.Line.exists_mono_in_high_dimension) + a linear 'generic projection' suffices. No genericity argument needed — taking the projection's first coordinate as the coordinate-SUM makes any combinatorial line's direction have first coord = |V| ≥ 1 > 0, so it is automatically nonzero and the k image points are distinct.

Affine identity φ(l a) = φ(l 0) + (a:ℝ)•dir proved at the module level (add_smul, mul_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.smul_sum) from the per-coordinate fact emb(l a j)=emb(l 0 j)+emb a*[varying]; nonzeroness pushed through WithLp.ofLp (linear) to a positive Finset sum.
The committed file at HEAD never compiled (last commit was 'UNVERIFIED — build host down'); a prior knowledge note claimed the build was fixed but that fix was not in the committed state.

The one-colour (Subsingleton nonempty palette) Ramsey number is EXACTLY k: ramseyNumberColored C k = k for k≥3. With a single colour the monochromaticity constraint is vacuous, so HasRamseyPropertyColored collapses to pure collinearity (∃ S⊆A, IsKCollinear S k); a k-point collinear witness pins R_C(k)=k. This is a SHARP value — unlike the genuinely open uncolored ramseyNumber k (only known ≥k) — precisely because there is no colouring left to defeat. Sharpens the earlier _subsingleton_le bound to an equality via le_antisymm with the existing lower bound.

The Ramsey property of Erdős #1090 is affine-invariant: if A witnesses it for k, so does every injective affine image b+L·A. Proof pulls the coloring back through the map, pushes the mono k-collinear subset forward (affine maps preserve collinearity with the SAME affine parameter t, direction stays nonzero because L is injective), card preserved by injectivity. Extremal configurations thus form affine-equivalence classes.

Confirmed Sylvester–Gallai is still NOT in Mathlib as of this toolchain: the only Mathlib `Sylvester` occurrences are the Sylvester matrix/resultant and Sylvester law of inertia. The SylvesterGallai placeholder def remains an out-of-session from-scratch target.
